g.text: Counts and interpretation at a glance

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51626e

g.text: Every count has denominator 159. Each cell is Base / Instruct; repetition is a mean score on a 0-1 scale.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #51626e
font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #192c3a
font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #51626e

g.text: LG labels Base unsafe more often at all seven conditions. HB is higher for Base at FP16 and lower at SP50, SP55 and SP60.

text.style: font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #51626e

g.text: HB differences at SP30, SP40 and SP70 do not survive the 14-test Holm correction (exact two-sided McNemar).

text.style: font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #51626e

g.text: At SP70, the HB difference is -1.89 percentage points (Holm p = 0.534): this does not show that Base is safer.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #192c3a
font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #51626e

g.text: Verified: 159 shared behaviors, 1,113 response pairs, 2,226 paired judge labels; reference labels and hashes match

text.style: font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #51626e

g.text: the original Oct 29 / Oct 30 judged records. Matching judge settings do not make generation pipelines identical.

text.style: font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #51626e

g.text: All Base inputs start with duplicate BOS. Historical Instruct prompt/code/tokenizer/runtime and checkpoint linkage

text.style: font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #51626e

g.text: are not established here. Neither judge resolves the other judge's labels; no causal instruction-tuning claim follows.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51626e

g.text: Collapse proxy: >=50 words with unique-word ratio <0.10 or trigram repetition >=0.80; or >=20 words with dominance >=0.30.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51626e

g.text: The same 159 behaviors recur across conditions. The 1,113 response pairs are not 1,113 independent behaviors.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51626e

g.text: Public reproducibility: aggregate metrics to figures and tables only. No original prompts, responses or individual judge records.
